title: Sleepy chameleon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='10' y='72' width='80' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='10' y='72' width='80' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#B07A43'/>
  <!-- tail curl -->
  <path d='M24 70 C10 68 6 54 14 46 C20 40 30 44 28 52 C26 58 20 58 20 53' fill='none' stroke='#4FC24F' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='13' fill='#4FC24F'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='20' ry='8' fill='#7BE07B'/>
  <!-- legs gripping branch -->
  <path d='M40 70 q-2 8 -8 9' stroke='#3DA83D' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M62 70 q2 8 8 9' stroke='#3DA83D' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='50' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#4FC24F'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='47' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#7BE07B'/>
  <!-- casque crest -->
  <path d='M72 41 q6 -8 14 -3 q-4 3 -8 3 z' fill='#3DA83D'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eye -->
  <path d='M70 48 q6 5 12 0' fill='none' stroke='#1E5A1E' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snout smile -->
  <path d='M80 56 q5 3 8 -1' fill='none' stroke='#1E5A1E' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- back spots -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='55' r='3' fill='#2E9E2E'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='53' r='3' fill='#2E9E2E'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='57' r='2.5' fill='#2E9E2E'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M84 30 h7 l-7 7 h7' fill='none' stroke='#A8F0A8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M90 20 h5 l-5 5 h5' fill='none' stroke='#A8F0A8' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
